the test environment blueprint (node types, DB classes).\n*   **Workshop 3: Support Governance & Operations (Target: Nov 22):**\n    *   Build the 4-week rotating on-call roster.\n    *   Map the with newly identified architectural and performance risks.\n    *   **Appendix B:** Detail test cases T-PERF-001 through T-PERF-004.\n    *   **Appendix H & I:** Insert the finalized Escalation Matrix
